rag.text:
Test: TC-4249 — Global - Task Configuration - "Overwrite Jira task data with data from the App" is disabled until Jira field is changed
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-117 Global - Task configuration
Labels: teamlego

Steps:
1. Navigate to App Configuration - General - Fields tab
   Expected: The fields tab is displayed

There are two sub-tabs: General mapping and Custom mapping

General mapping page contains list of fields:

* Start date (camera icon is present)
* End date (camera icon is present)
* Baseline start date (camera icon is present)
* Baseline end date (camera icon is present)
* Team Code
* Milestone field (camera icon is present)
* Story Points
* Required Skills
* Actual cost
* Estimated cost
* Progress
* Scheduling mode (camera icon is present)

In the middle there are icons with two arrows pointing in both directions ⇆

At the bottom there is section with "Additional task settings" with 5 toggle buttons, Save button and Reset to defaults button

Next to "Fields" and "Additional task settings" there is question mark icon with link to help page.
2. Scroll down to "*Additional task settings*" section and 

click on inactive toggle "*Overwrite Jira task data with data from the App*"
   Expected: The toggle is not changing the state and remains inactive
3. Set *Start date* field to {StartDateValue1}
   Data: StartDateValue1 = "*Target start*"
   Expected: The value is changed and toggle "*Overwrite Jira task data with data from the App*" is now active

BeLow appears new section: *"FolLowing changes will be applied"* which contains information about changes in *Start date* field
4. Click on toggle "*Overwrite Jira task data with data from the App*"
   Expected: It changes its' state to green.

*"FolLowing changes will be applied" section* which contains additional information about toggle changing status from *false* to *true*
5. Click on "Reset to defaults" button
   Expected: * Confirmation modal appears: "_Are you sure?_ _All custom changes you've made will be overwritten with default settings. This action cannot be undone._" with buttons "Reset now" and "Cancel"
6. Click on "Reset now"
   Expected: * *Start date* field changes value from "*Target* *start*" back to "*Start* *date*".
* Toggle "*Overwrite Jira task data with data from the App*" changes state to false and inactive.
* *"FolLowing changes will be applied"* section disappears.
